notes: Solved independently: M_A/M_B = 8 × 2^(−t/T) ÷ 2^(−t/2T) = 8 × 2^(−t/2T). Setting this to 4 gives 2^(−t/2T) = 1/2, so t = 2T. Option 1. Checked numerically for t = 0.5T, T, 2T, 3T, 4T; only t = 2T gives a ratio of exactly 4. The solution's substitution m = t/2T with A completing 2m half-lives is a different but valid route, and each of its four equations follows from the one above: 8/2^(2m) ÷ 1/2^m does simplify to 8/2^m. Both common_mistakes entries reproduce the option they point at (option 2 from converting m back with T instead of 2T; option 3 from reading 2^m = 2 as m = 2, giving t = 4T).
